discussion_comments.comment_body: please do not manually update sdk, perform full generation instead
Hi @sonalsingh-msft the CI is failing because the manual update of generated SDK is not allowed. Please update `src/Network/Network.Management.Sdk/README.md` instead to generate latest SDK

Hi @NoriZC , the DisablePeeringRoute property exists only in the 2025-07-01 API version ([azure-rest-api-specs#42058](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/sonalsingh/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/560a9dba96/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)), and the TypeSpec migration restructured all swagger paths (66 individual files → ~16 consolidated files under a new directory layout). Updating the README would mean rewriting all input-file paths and regenerating ~1,600 files — a full SDK version bump that needs coordinated team effort.

Other PRs on this branch use the same approach, e.g., [#29418](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/sonalsingh/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/560a9dba96/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) which notes: "SDK model files were manually created...will be overwritten once full SDK generation from the 2025-07-01 TypeSpec-consolidated swagger is completed."

Branch has been rebased on latest release-network-2025-07-01.
